profile.name: Younus Ali
profile.title: Operations & Program Support Specialist
profile.intro: I run verification case operations end-to-end and build the AI-powered tools that make them faster — while carrying a background in community development and climate-resilience work from Gilgit-Baltistan.

responsibilities: Initiate and manage partner verification cases end-to-end, reviewing candidate information and documents under strict data-confidentiality standards.
Maintain real-time case tracking dashboards in Google Sheets, ensuring on-time progression against turnaround deadlines.
Primary liaison between Operations and Management on case status, feasibility, and escalations.
Source, onboard, and brief freelance verification agents across low-coverage global regions via LinkedIn and professional networks.
key_achievements: Built a ChatGPT assistant that automates task instructions and briefing documents, cutting manual prep time per case.
Designed a DeepSeek-based sourcing assistant that structured 800+ raw freelancer records into a searchable database.
Reactivated 30–40 dormant high-value freelancers through advanced web research and contact-discovery methods.

responsibilities: Managed end-to-end property sales operations and a portfolio of active client relationships.
Generated qualified leads through targeted social media and public-awareness campaigns.
key_achievements: Closed approximately 5 million PKR in property sales in 2024.

responsibilities: Supported community-driven programs in social uplift, youth empowerment, and climate resilience across Gilgit-Baltistan.
Conducted community needs assessments, including population data estimation.
Contributed to the Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) disaster-risk-reduction project, supporting climate adaptation planning.
Liaised between project teams, local communities, indigenous organizations, and government bodies.
Designed and delivered structured lesson plans for elementary students in core subjects.
Collaborated with local educators to promote access to education in an underserved community.
